segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: visual situation classification and strategy rationale
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Visually it looked almost identical to a fire we had three years back ... So my first read was, this looks like that one.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant classifies the current fire from a specific prior incident using superficial visual similarity before contents are confirmed.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Get the fire knocked down before it could threaten the second tank or the production building next door, and do it without losing anybody.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a standard life-safety, stabilization, and property-protection objective without a hidden bias mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: verbal risk framing and information-prioritization rationale
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The call came through as contained ... getting the manifest nailed down didn't feel like something I had to sort out before we started moving lines in.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The dispatcher's specific 'contained' wording is treated as an operative low-severity frame despite unconfirmed contents.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It should have, and it registered, but we were already committed ... the plan stayed as it was; we didn't stop and rebuild the IAP.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The original IAP continues because no formal stop or reassessment is triggered after material new hazard information.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We already had people and hose in position — pulling that back felt like giving up ground we'd already paid for.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Continuation is partly justified by already-invested setup time, crews, hose, and risk.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: internal dissent handling and consensus rationale
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Everybody sort of nodded that we were fine to continue ... Nobody asked him to lay out specifically what he was seeing ... it just didn't come back up.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The command post acknowledges but does not substantively test the safety officer's dissent before reaching rapid agreement.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: When you've got multiple experienced officers on the net independently saying the same thing, that carries weight.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Multiple agreeing mutual-aid officers on the shared radio net reinforce continuation of the existing tactical interpretation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: final evidence integration and withdrawal timing
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The spotter's call was the most current thing I had in my ear ... I let one fresh comment outweigh a much longer pattern that had already told a consistent story.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A single recent verbal report is weighted over a sustained twenty-minute instrument trend in the withdrawal decision.
